agent.name: Embedded Project Idea Scoping Agent
agent.context: Embedded Engineering and Gen AI Summer School for third-year Computer Science students
agent.purpose: Convert a vague embedded project idea into a structured scoping brief for requirements engineering

source_input.original_project_idea: Multi-Mode Touchscreen Audio Workstation: Real-Time FFT Analyzer, Smart Recorder & Digital Synthesizer using NXP FRDM-MCXA153, 2.4-inch ILI9341 SPI TFT LCD Touchscreen with SD Card Slot, MAX4466 mic, 3.5mm AUX jacks, DFPlayer Mini MP3 player, ESP8266 Wi-Fi module, and TP4056 power module.

fixed_platform.pin_policy: Use generic capabilities unless exact pins are provided
fixed_platform.logic_level_policy: Assume 3.3 V logic unless verified otherwise

project.name: Multi-Mode Touchscreen Audio Workstation: Real-Time FFT Analyzer, Smart Recorder & Digital Synthesizer
project.short_summary: A portable dual-mode embedded audio processing instrument on FRDM-MCXA153 featuring real-time FFT spectrum visualization, audio recording to SD Card, DFPlayer playback, touchscreen piano synth, and ESP8266 Wi-Fi telemetry.
project.main_objective: Build a multi-functional digital audio workstation combining real-time signal analysis (FFT), audio storage/playback, interactive synthesis, and IoT telemetry on a single MCU platform.
project.main_behavior: Sampling audio via ADC+DMA, rendering 60 FPS FFT spectrum on 2.4" TFT Touch LCD, managing WAV recording/playback on SD Card, synthesizing audio notes on touch input, and streaming telemetry via ESP8266 Wi-Fi.
outputs: DFPlayer Mini audio output to 3.5mm headphone jack
interaction_flow: Display Main Menu on Touchscreen (Mode A: Spectrum Analyzer & Recorder vs Mode B: Touch Synthesizer & Effects)
In Mode A: render live FFT spectrum/waveform, touch controls to record WAV to SD Card or trigger DFPlayer playback
In Mode B: render touch piano keyboard, synthesize waveforms on touch, trigger backing tracks from SD Card
ESP8266 streams telemetry data and handles Web-MIDI remote events in background
out_of_scope: Direct 5V logic driving without level translation

problem_space.purpose: Demonstrate high-performance real-time DSP, GUI rendering, file system management, and wireless IoT telemetry on Cortex-M33.
problem_space.physical_process_monitored_or_controlled: Acoustic audio signals (20Hz-20kHz) and user touch gestures.
success_criteria: Stable 60 FPS FFT spectrum display on ILI9341 TFT LCD
Reliable WAV audio recording to SD Card via SPI
Audio playback via DFPlayer Mini without buffer underruns
Low-latency touch response for synthesizer keyboard
Wi-Fi telemetry transmission over ESP8266 UART
known_constraints: Maximum internal ADC sampling rate 40-50 kHz for audio
SPI bus shared between ILI9341 TFT and SD Card slot
unknown_constraints: SPI bus bandwidth limit when driving 320x240 TFT LCD and writing SD Card concurrently
Exact power consumption under full Wi-Fi TX + TFT backlight

core_student_version.description: Basic audio spectrum analyzer rendering live FFT on 2.4" TFT LCD and playing pre-stored tracks via DFPlayer.
expected_features: Spectrum bar graph on ILI9341 TFT LCD
core_student_version.why_it_is_suitable: Focuses on core DSP and SPI display drivers without complex file systems or wireless networking.

recommended_summer_school_version.description: Dual-mode Touch Audio Workstation featuring FFT spectrum, touchscreen GUI navigation, SD Card recording/playback, and DFPlayer control.
expected_features: Dual-mode Touch UI (Mode A: Spectrum/Recorder, Mode B: Touch Synth)
WAV file recording to SD Card over FatFS/SPI
DFPlayer Mini UART control for audio playback
recommended_summer_school_version.why_it_is_interesting: Combines real-time DSP, touch UI, embedded file systems, and hardware audio decoding into a rich student demo.
recommended_summer_school_version.why_it_is_still_feasible: Achievable within summer school timeframe using modular drivers and FreeRTOS / superloop architecture.

advanced_extension.description: Full IoT Connected Workstation with ESP8266 Web Dashboard, Web-MIDI remote control, and cloud telemetry logging.
advanced_features: ESP8266 UART Wi-Fi bridge hosting interactive Web Dashboard
Web-MIDI remote synth triggering over Wi-Fi
MQTT/HTTP cloud telemetry logging of spectral data
technical_challenges: Multi-protocol concurrent communication (SPI TFT, SPI SD, UART DFPlayer, UART ESP8266)
DMA buffer synchronization under heavy CPU load
risk_controls: Isolate ESP8266 tasks to non-blocking background UART queues
Provide fallback standalone mode if Wi-Fi connection fails

main_board.name: NXP FRDM-MCXA153
main_board.reasoning: Mandatory board for all summer school projects

sensors.name: MAX4466 Microphone Module
sensors.voltage_or_signal_notes: 3.3V VCC, analog output centered at VCC/2 (1.65V)
risks: Overvoltage input spike if exposed to high volume

actuators_outputs.name: DFPlayer Mini MP3/WAV Player
actuators_outputs.purpose: Hardware audio playback to headphone jack
actuators_outputs.voltage_or_power_notes: Requires 3.3V-5V VCC; RX line needs 1k resistor if driven from 5V system
risks: Peak current consumption when driving low-impedance headphones

user_inputs.name: Resistive Touchscreen (XPT2046 / Analog)
user_inputs.purpose: GUI menu navigation and piano synth keyboard

user_inputs.name: Onboard Pushbuttons (SW2, SW3)
user_inputs.purpose: Quick mode toggle and hardware reset/trigger
user_inputs.notes: Directly connected to MCU GPIO pins

display_ui.name: 2.4" ILI9341 SPI TFT LCD Display
display_ui.purpose: Real-time FFT spectrum, waveform, and Touch GUI rendering

communication_debug.name: ESP8266 Wi-Fi Module
communication_debug.purpose: Wireless web dashboard and cloud telemetry
communication_debug.notes: Requires stable 3.3V power supply (up to 300mA peak during Wi-Fi TX)

power_source.recommended_power: 18650 Li-ion battery via TP4056 charger and 3.3V regulator
risks: High current surge during Wi-Fi transmission

optional_advanced_components.name: 3.5mm AUX Stereo Line-In Jack
optional_advanced_components.purpose: Direct audio signal measurement from external phone/instrument
optional_advanced_components.reason_to_include: Enables precise oscilloscope measurements without acoustic room noise
optional_advanced_components.reason_to_exclude: Requires Zener diode input protection circuit

software_context.recommended_development_environment: MCUXpresso SDK + CMake + VS Code / MCUXpresso IDE
software_context.suggested_starting_point: FRDM-MCXA153 SDK LPI2C / LPSPI / LPADC baseline examples

constraints.voltage: Assume 3.3 V logic unless verified otherwise
constraints.timing: FFT calculation & screen refresh loop within 16.6ms (60 FPS)
constraints.safety: Input voltage clamping (0V to 3.3V) on analog inputs
constraints.privacy_security: Local audio storage on SD Card; Wi-Fi telemetry opt-in

complexity.reason: Uses standard MCUXpresso SDK drivers, CMSIS-DSP library, and modular peripheral interfaces.

facts_provided_by_user: Display is 2.4" ILI9341 SPI TFT LCD with Touchscreen and SD Card slot
Audio input via MAX4466 mic and 3.5mm AUX jack
Audio output via DFPlayer Mini and 3.5mm headphone jack

assumptions.assumption: The ILI9341 TFT display controller and SD Card slot share the SPI bus using separate Chip Select (CS) GPIO lines.
assumptions.reason: Standard breakout board pinout for ILI9341 + SD slot

assumptions.assumption: Analog audio input uses a 10k resistor and 3.3V Zener diode for overvoltage protection.
assumptions.reason: Protects MCXA153 ADC pin from excessive voltage swings

open_questions.question: Will SPI bus sharing between LCD and SD Card cause frame drops during SD writing?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Determines if double-buffering or DMA priority is required

technical: SPI bus contention between TFT display and SD Card
ADC sampling noise from Wi-Fi module power spikes
safety: Li-ion battery short circuit if un-protected
voltage_power: Inadequate 3.3V power rail causing MCU brown-out when ESP8266 transmits
timing: FFT computation taking longer than 16.6ms at high resolution
memory: Audio recording buffer overflowing internal SRAM
privacy_security: Unencrypted Wi-Fi transmission of audio telemetry
advanced_feature_risks: ESP8266 UART packet drops under heavy web traffic

human_approval_required: Confirm SPI CS pin allocations for ILI9341 and SD Card slot
Approve analog input Zener protection circuit

handoff_to_requirements_agent.readiness_notes: Scoping brief is complete and ready for requirements expansion.
